paper.title: LLMs as Continuous Learners: Improving the Reproduction of Defective Code in Software Issues
paper.central_claim: EvoCoder continuously distills general and repository-specific experience, maintains it through action-based editing, and improves issue reproduction and downstream issue resolving without fine-tuning.
paper.scope_class: A: retained editable textual experience pool

provenance.notes: Assigned model type sonnet maps to gpt-6.1-sol; environment identifies gpt-6.1-sol. No independent runtime receipt or session identifier exposed; actual_model left null per worker template. No model probing.

sections_read: Complete fixed HTML lines 1–1191 through EOF: abstract, §§1–10, all actor/reflection/judge prompts, Tables 1–2 and figure captions. No appendix or page_images supplied in this version; image-only examples/transitions not independently decoded.

evidence.quote: our approach does not require fine-tuning; instead, it facilitates the model’s ability to continuously update and optimize its stored experiences when addressing new challenges.
evidence.support_explanation: Non-weight retained-state loop is explicitly the adaptation object.

evidence.quote: To enable effective experience refinement, we design an LLM-based reflection mechanism that analyzes task trajectories and golden test patches to continuously update the experience pool.
evidence.support_explanation: Oracle test patches inform reflection; separates scientific mechanism from label-free deployment claims.

evidence.quote: If the length of EXISTING RULES is greater than 20, you must use remove or merge at least once.
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit anti-bloat editing heuristic, not empirical guarantee of useful bounded memory.

evidence.quote: Upon a new issue, the Actor LM selects both common and repo-specific experiences from the experience pool. For each repository, at most 10 experiences can be selected.
evidence.support_explanation: Later issues receive persisted experience; selection uses importance rather than semantic task relevance.

evidence.quote: This subset comprises 300 instances from SWE-bench that have been sampled to be more self-contained and covers 11 out of the original 12 repositories
We did not use automatic metrics because there is a lack of ground-truth answers for reproducing code in the selected dataset.
evidence.support_explanation: Reproduction uses human/model judgments rather than independent executable ground-truth equivalence.

evidence.quote: The input provided to the model includes the content of the issue, the reproduced code, and the execution result of the code.
evidence.support_explanation: Judge grounded in executed output, although judge calibration and blinding not reported.
Strongest baseline comparison: 9pp model-judged and 8.33pp human-judged, not 20 absolute points.

evidence.quote: Specifically, we tested the removal of the action-based update mechanism, the exclusion of repository-specific experiences, and the elimination of general experiences.
evidence.support_explanation: Editing-policy and store-scope ablations exist, beyond just comparing entire systems.

evidence.quote: by applying EvoCoder to AutoCodeRover, the number of resolved issues increases from 15 to 18, an approximation of 20% improvement.
evidence.support_explanation: Small downstream increment; Table2 implies denominator68, selection not clearly specified.

evidence.quote: the model’s output failed to capture the error message both before and after integrating these experiences.
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit negative transfer/use case limits claims of general resolution.

evidence.quote: is defined as a rule guiding what the Agent must do to avoid a certain reproduction failure or follow unique coding styles that certain code repositories may have.
evidence.support_explanation: Experience is generalized guidance, not a stored target patch.

signatures.object: General and repository-specific natural-language experience pools
signatures.information: Actor Thought-Action-Response trajectories, issue text, golden test patch, existing rules
signatures.operation: Reflect on reproduction failures/successes; split general/repo rules; AGREE/REMOVE/ADD/EDIT/MERGE existing rules; rank and inject selected rules into subsequent issue prompts.
signatures.output: Curated persistent rules outside frozen model weights
signatures.conditions: Golden patches available to reflector; repeated repository tasks; reliable rule abstraction and correct pool assignment
signatures.feedback: Actual code execution plus golden-test comparison and model/human reproduction judgments
signatures.selection_rule: At most four update operations; mandatory remove/merge when existing rules>20; initial importance2, AGREE increments1; select up to10 experiences per repository by importance.
signatures.selection_data: Completed reproduction trajectories and their golden patches; no disjoint construction/evaluation split specified
signatures.persistence: Shared general pool and repo-specific pools survive issue boundaries
signatures.later_use: Actor receives accumulated rules for later issues, with scope restricted by repository
signatures.claimed_effect: Improved reproduction accuracy, action-based updating and downstream patch selection
signatures.failure_boundary: Gold-patch exposure, unspecified stream ordering, judge-driven errors, generic rules and missing utility-based rollback
